name: plan-board-load
description: Load-only performance capture for the Plan board. Opens /plan, waits for the board frame and rendered cards, and records card counts without driving interaction input.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 45000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="plan-card"], article').length; if (cards >= 20) return { cards }; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="plan-card"], article').length; throw new Error(`plan-board-load: board evidence too small; cards=${cards}`); })()

(() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="plan-card"], article').length; performance.mark('bas.plan-board-load.ready'); window.localStorage.setItem('swarm-manager.perf.plan-board-load.size', JSON.stringify({ cards })); return { cards }; })()

metadata.label: Record rendered board size for trace notes
